q: During sarpanch poll in Anakapalli, armed men snatch ballot box at booth. As sector SI, immediate lawful steps?
options: Secure booth, protect polling party, report to RO for repoll decision and register robbery/capture case
Allow snatchers to cast remaining votes
expl: SI protects personnel/material and reports capture.
why: Police do not decide election outcome. Prompt sealing, witness record and FIR preserve both poll integrity and prosecution.
trapnote: Trap: SI orders repoll or result.

q: In Araku Agency, a mining truck shows district permit but tribals say village council never agreed. Contractor demands lathi-charge. Your call?
options: Hold order, verify Gram Sabha consent mandatory in Scheduled Area; refer dispute to SDM/ITDA, no forcible eviction
expl: PESA mandates Gram Sabha consent for land/mining in Scheduled Areas.
why: Consent is substantive safeguard, not formality. SI keeps peace while revenue authority verifies consent record.
trapnote: Trap: treats collector permit as substitute for consent.

q: Inter-district nakabandi between NTR and Eluru fails as constables use old 13-district map and wrong SP control. Your correction?
options: Continue with old map for convenience
Apply 26-district map of 2022 reorganisation; coordinate with correct DPOs and update checkpost directory
Abandon coordination as districts keep changing
why: Wrong district routing delays response and remand. Updating to notified map fixes command and accountability.

q: Sarpanch seat reserved for women. Defeated male candidate blocks winner from entering office claiming custom. Duty?
options: Enforce SEC reservation notification; give protection for charge-taking and bind over obstructors
Ask winner to get civil decree first
expl: Rotation/reservation notified by State Election Commission binds.
why: Street veto cannot defeat constitutional reservation. Protection plus preventive action preserves mandate without SI judging title.
trapnote: Trap: demands civil suit before protection.

q: Panchayat secretary and municipal inspector quarrel over a new layout on Nagar Panchayat fringe during poll code. How to fix jurisdiction?
options: Check Governor's notification of rural-urban area and SEC/ULB rolls; maintain order till RO clarifies booth mapping
expl: Rural-urban divide and booth mapping flow from notified area and electoral roll.
why: Jurisdiction turns on notification, not appearance. Acting without paper creates double polling or disenfranchisement.
